messages:
Asha: TerraFlux EAP kickoff — partner asked for an expedited bench + a short NDA addendum. Need owners for legal, bench matrix, telemetry schema, and marketplace blurb. Who's in?

Ben: I can do bench coordination. Lab window looks like 7/11-7/15 (UTC). We'll test perf, stability soak, and model-variant fallbacks. Need partner image + creds.

Marta: Legal: will need a concise clause: no raw prompt capture, hashed request ids allowed, aggregated metrics only. Partner asked for 90-day artifact retention instead of our usual 30. Is that acceptable?

Ibrahim: Ops note: marketplace requires approved logo (SVG), 2-sentence blurb, and an approved customer quote for co-listing. We also schedule a short joint webinar. I'll draft the blurb if you give me a couple bullets.

Asha: On retention: prefer 30 days, but partner has compliance that wants 90. Can we allow 90 for EAP with KMS encryption and reviewed scope? Marta?

Marta: OK we can allow 90 days for EAP only, provided artifacts are encrypted with KMS, and clause states "aggregated metrics + cryptographic hashes only; no plaintext prompts or responses may be retained beyond test artifacts." I'll push an addendum by EOD.

Ben: Bench plan: run three phases -> cold-cold (cache off), warm-steady (cache on), and 24h soak. Suggested flags: `./bench --model=redwood-13b --seq=2048 --batch=1 --samples=400 --cache=on|off` Capture `p50,p95,p99,gpu_util_pct,kv_hit_rate,mem_mb`. Save outputs as `terraflux_eap_<date>_<phase>.json`.

Ibrahim: Telemetry constraints from partner: only counters and percentiles, no prompt text. They want an endpoint `/metrics/terraflux-eap` with: `tokens_total`, `tokens_per_sec`, `p95_ms`, `gpu_util_pct`, `kv_hit_rate`. Can we add hashed request id metric like `req_hash_count`?

Asha: Hashed ids ok as long as we state cryptographic hash alg in NDA. Also need partner sign-off for the exact metric set. OpsBot, attach checklist.

OpsBot: Uploaded checklist: `drive.redwood.com/terraflux/eap-playbook-v1.md`. Includes telemetry schema stub, bench matrix, and minimal reproduce scripts.

Ben: Example pre-run output (sanitized):
```
{"model":"redwood-13b","phase":"warm","p50_ms":38.2,"p95_ms":121.7,"p99_ms":210.4,"gpu_util_pct":81.3}
```

Marta: NDA draft will include: (1) aggregated metrics + hashes only; (2) retention = 90 days for EAP artifacts; (3) KMS encryption required; (4) partner cannot request raw prompts. I'll ping when uploaded.

Ibrahim: For marketplace blurb: couple bullets we can use: low-latency inference on partner silicon, enterprise-ready private deployment, verified perf on TerraFlux nodes. I'll draft 80-100 words and circulate with comms.

Asha: Timeline proposal: Marta NDA by EOD, Ben bench dry-run by 7/12, full run + artifacts uploaded by 7/14, marketplace draft by 7/17, soft co-list 7/24. Sync Mon 9am UTC to review.

Ben: Will include runbook snippets and a short Docker image repro. Also record `cache_mode` in artifacts. :memo:

Marta: Quick Q: partner requested hashed request ids use SHA-256. We'll include that spec.

Asha: Good. Callout: partner asked for a short public quote; don't promise specifics. Ibrahim, send quote template.

Ibrahim: Will do. Adding comms to loop and requesting logo files (SVG + PNG).

Asha: Action recap in-thread: Marta -> NDA addendum; Ben -> bench runs + artifacts; Ibrahim -> blurb + logo + quote template; OpsBot -> keep playbook updated. Meeting Mon 9am UTC.

Ben: Uploading initial artifacts to drive when done and will ping link here. :thumbsup:
